office: the Civil Registry and Migration Department, which issues every card at its central offices in Nicosia; abroad, a consular authority such as the High Commission in London

routes.label: at a Cypriot consular authority, charged in local currency

note: Holding a card is compulsory from 12, optional below. The fees, 30 euros for an adult and 20 for a minor, are the High Commission in London's (in pounds at the month's rate) and Sigmalive's (31 July 2025), which also gives the validity, ten years for an adult and five for a minor. The Civil Registry and Migration Department's own pages answer 403 or 404. No processing time is given for the card.

sources.title: High Commission of the Republic of Cyprus in the UK, ID Card / Passport / Emergency Travel Document
sources.said: The acquisition and possession of a Civil Identity Card is compulsory for any person who has completed twelve years of age and is provisional for minors below that age . ... Fee Adults: The equivalent of €30.00 in £/GBP. Fee Minors (under 18 y/o): The equivalent of €20.00 in £/GBP. Our price list is updated monthly depending on the current currency exchange.

sources.title: Sigmalive, All you need to know about last-minute ID or passport renewal? (31 July 2025)
sources.said: Issuance/renewal of adult ID card: €30 Issuance/renewal of minor’s ID card: €20 ... All ID cards are issued at the central offices of the Civil Registry and Migration Department in Nicosia. ... ID cards are valid for 10 years for adults and 5 years for minors.
